svg.title: How a WYRM site fits together
svg.desc: Devices are polled by links. The links publish values and meta into one wyrmd, where the admin, the flow engine, the historian, storage and the embedded links sit beside the Zenoh router. Studio, wyrm-agent and MCP clients come in through the user gateway. An upstream site connects over QUIC with mTLS.
